title: Qualcomm Ventures joins WEKA's $140M Series E

sources.quote: Generation Investment Management, NVIDIA, Atreides Management, 10D, Hitachi Ventures, Ibex Investors, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, MoreTech Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures joined Valor in contributing to the round.

explain: Qualcomm's venture arm took part in WEKA's $140 million round at a $1.6 billion valuation. WEKA sells data storage software used in AI clusters; Qualcomm's amount was not disclosed.
